entries.title: Keep secrets your crew uses only with your approval
entries.body: Settings → Secrets keeps keys and passwords on this computer, locked by the Mac's Keychain or your Linux system's secret store. A crewmate can ask to use one for a program it runs, and each use waits for you on its own card: confirm it with Touch ID or your password, from a paired phone, or with a decision you saved. On a Mac the value never reaches the crew; on Linux, any program you run can reach it while your system's secret store is unlocked. The Linux AppImage takes approvals from a paired phone only.
